mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation(title, user_id, model, status, create_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{userId}, #{model}, 1, #{createBy}, GETDATE(), GETDATE())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation SET title = #{title}, update_time = GETDATE() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE ai_conversation SET status = 0, update_time = GETDATE() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 50 * FROM ai_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY update_time DESC
SELECT * FROM ai_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_message(conversation_id, role, content, tokens, create_time) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{tokens}, GETDATE())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TOP (#{limit}) * FROM ai_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id DESC ) AS t ORDER BY id ASC
